decision_rule: A calibration candidate requires a complete full-run record with 20 fresh A/A pairs in each of SETTLED, PREHEATED and successful POST_BUILD, all invocations GPU-resident, and pp512 bootstrap floors with provenance; review calibration and re-adjudication before updating the table. Partial measured units and dry-run PASS are not a floor verdict. Scope: Qwen3.8-27B Q8_0 exact prepared GGUF. SMOKE_UNSETTLED smoke invocations are excluded from every calibration condition; only full-run SETTLED originals establish a target-specific floor.
